mapper.sql: SELECT p.policy_id, p.policy_no, p.policy_name, p.customer_id, p.basis, p.period_type, p.tier_min, p.tier_max, p.rebate_rate, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.status, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, c.customer_name FROM mk_rebate_policy p LEFT JOIN mk_customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
mapper.select: WHERE p.policy_no = #{policyNo} AND p.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY p.tier_min ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_rebate_policy (policy_no, policy_name, customer_id, basis, period_type, tier_min, tier_max, rebate_rate, start_date, end_date, status, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{policyNo}, #{policyName}, #{customerId}, #{basis}, #{periodType}, #{tierMin}, #{tierMax}, #{rebateRate}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})

INSERT INTO mk_rebate_settle (settle_no, customer_id, customer_name, period, policy_no, policy_name, achieve_amount, rebate_rate, rebate_amount, status, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{settleNo}, #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{period}, #{policyNo}, #{policyName}, #{achieveAmount}, #{rebateRate}, #{rebateAmount}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
